component.name: MediaTaskProbe
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runProbe" end sub
sub runProbe() ' Each phase is wrapped so one crashing/invalidated node can't stop the rest of the probe ' from running and reporting. try probeDirectPoster() catch e print "PROBE|019|poster-direct|phase-crash|" + e.message end try try probeDirectAnimatedImage() catch e print "PROBE|029|animatedimage-direct|phase-crash|" + e.message end try try probeXmlAttrPoster() catch e print "PROBE|039|poster-xmlattr|phase-crash|" + e.message end try try probeXmlAttrAnimatedImage() catch e print "PROBE|049|animatedimage-xmlattr|phase-crash|" + e.message end try m.top.finished = true end sub
' Reads p.loadStatus without ever letting a dead/invalidated node crash the caller. function safeLoadStatus(p as object) as string result = "?" try result = p.loadStatus catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
function safeState(a as object) as string result = "?" try result = a.state catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
' Polls fieldReader(node) every 30ms for up to durationMs, logging each tick under `tag` -- ' brackets exactly when a node stops being safely accessible, without needing the debugger. sub pollField(tag as string, node as object, fieldReader as function, durationMs as integer) elapsed = 0 while elapsed < durationMs sleep(30) elapsed = elapsed + 30 print "PROBE|" + tag + "|poll|elapsedMs=" + elapsed.toStr() + " value=" + fieldReader(node) end while end sub
' Direct CreateObject + imperative uri write (no XML attribute involved) -- the baseline: does ' a Task-created Poster load at all, stay valid, and does its observer fire on this thread? sub probeDirectPoster() print "PROBE|010|poster-direct|create|begin=" p = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Poster") print "PROBE|011|poster-direct|create|subtype=" + p.subtype() if p.subtype() <> "Poster" print "PROBE|012|poster-direct|create|end=not-a-node" return end if m.posterObservedCount = 0 m.p = p p.observeField("loadStatus", "onPosterStatus") print "PROBE|013|poster-direct|before-uri|loadStatus=" + safeLoadStatus(p) try p.uri = "pkg:/images/probe.png" print "PROBE|014|poster-direct|uri-write|ok" catch e print "PROBE|014|poster-direct|uri-write|CRASH:" + e.message end try print "PROBE|015|poster-direct|after-uri-sync|loadStatus=" + safeLoadStatus(p) pollField("017|poster-direct", p, safeLoadStatus, 300) print "PROBE|018|poster-direct|after-settle|loadStatus=" + safeLoadStatus(p) + " observedCount=" + m.posterObservedCount.toStr() end sub
' The observer body itself may run with a DIFFERENT `m` than the one runProbe()/ ' probeDirectPoster() used (theory: a rendering node's observer dispatches on the render ' thread, with its own `m`, not the Task's) -- so every access is diagnostic-first, never ' assuming `m` still has what the creating code put there. sub onPosterStatus() print "PROBE|016a|poster-direct|observer|m-count=" + m.count().toStr() print "PROBE|016b|poster-direct|observer|has-posterObservedCount=" + m.DoesExist("posterObservedCount").toStr() print "PROBE|016c|poster-direct|observer|has-p=" + m.DoesExist("p").toStr() if m.DoesExist("posterObservedCount") m.posterObservedCount = m.posterObservedCount + 1 end if status = "no-p-in-m" if m.DoesExist("p") status = safeLoadStatus(m.p) end if print "PROBE|016|poster-direct|observer|loadStatus=" + status end sub
sub probeDirectAnimatedImage() print "PROBE|020|animatedimage-direct|create|begin=" a = CreateObject("roSGNode", "AnimatedImage") print "PROBE|021|animatedimage-direct|create|subtype=" + a.subtype() if a.subtype() <> "AnimatedImage" print "PROBE|022|animatedimage-direct|create|end=not-a-node" return end if m.animObservedCount = 0 m.a = a a.observeField("state", "onAnimState") print "PROBE|023|animatedimage-direct|before-uri|state=" + safeState(a) try a.uri = "pkg:/images/animated.webp" a.control = "loop" print "PROBE|024|animatedimage-direct|uri-write|ok" catch e print "PROBE|024|animatedimage-direct|uri-write|CRASH:" + e.message end try print "PROBE|025|animatedimage-direct|after-uri-sync|state=" + safeState(a) pollField("027|animatedimage-direct", a, safeState, 300) print "PROBE|028|animatedimage-direct|after-settle|state=" + safeState(a) + " observedCount=" + m.animObservedCount.toStr() end sub
sub onAnimState() print "PROBE|026a|animatedimage-direct|observer|m-count=" + m.count().toStr() print "PROBE|026b|animatedimage-direct|observer|has-animObservedCount=" + m.DoesExist("animObservedCount").toStr() print "PROBE|026c|animatedimage-direct|observer|has-a=" + m.DoesExist("a").toStr() if m.DoesExist("animObservedCount") m.animObservedCount = m.animObservedCount + 1 end if status = "no-a-in-m" if m.DoesExist("a") status = safeState(m.a) end if print "PROBE|026|animatedimage-direct|observer|state=" + status end sub
' uri is an XML attribute on the child -- applied during ITS construction, before its own ' init() can observeField. See PosterXmlChild.xml for the case this reproduces. sub probeXmlAttrPoster() print "PROBE|030|poster-xmlattr|create|begin=" c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "PosterXmlChild") pollField("034|poster-xmlattr", c, safeChildPosterStatus, 300) print "PROBE|033|poster-xmlattr|after-settle|loadStatus=" + safeChildPosterStatus(c) + " observed=" + safeChildObserved(c) end sub
function safeChildObserved(c as object) as string result = "?" try result = c.observed.toStr() catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
function safeChildPosterStatus(c as object) as string result = "?" try result = c.findNode("p").loadStatus catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
sub probeXmlAttrAnimatedImage() print "PROBE|040|animatedimage-xmlattr|create|begin=" c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "AnimatedImageXmlChild") pollField("044|animatedimage-xmlattr", c, safeChildAnimState, 300) print "PROBE|043|animatedimage-xmlattr|after-settle|state=" + safeChildAnimState(c) + " observedCount=" + safeChildObservedCount(c) end sub
function safeChildObservedCount(c as object) as string result = "?" try result = c.observedCount.toStr() catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
function safeChildAnimState(c as object) as string result = "?" try result = c.findNode("a").state catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
